WITH old_call AS(SELECT e.source_node_id,e.target_label,e.scope_text,e.receiver_text,e.bind_method,e.target_node_id FROM frozen.main.edges e WHERE e.logical_path=? AND e.relation='calls' AND e.target_label='TrustLost'),
new_edges AS (SELECT unnest(v.edges) e FROM fresh),new_call AS (SELECT e.source_node_id,e.target_label,e.scope_text,e.receiver_text,e.bind_method,e.target_node_id FROM new_edges WHERE e.relation='calls' AND e.target_label='TrustLost')
SELECT 'old' AS version,* FROM old_call UNION ALL SELECT 'new',* FROM new_call ORDER BY source_node_id,version
